tooltips.name: The name of the unique index, e.g. unique_relationship. Only lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscores are allowed.
tooltips.fields: The fields the unique index consists of. The `deleted` column is always added to the index as the first column. At least two fields are required.

exceptions.indexNameIsInvalid: The name of the unique index is invalid. It should start with a lowercase Latin letter, should not end with an underscore and can contain lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscores only.
exceptions.atLeastTwoFieldsRequired: A unique index should consist of at least two fields. To make a single field unique, enable the 'Unique' checkbox in the field settings.
exceptions.indexFieldsShouldBeUnique: The same field cannot be used in the unique index twice.
exceptions.fieldCannotBeUsedInUniqueIndex: The field '%s' has no own column in the table and cannot be used in the unique index.
exceptions.fieldTypeCannotBeUsedInUniqueIndex: The type of the field '%s' is not supported by unique indexes.
exceptions.duplicateValuesExist: The unique index cannot be created: the table already contains duplicate values for the selected fields: %s
exceptions.indexNameAlreadyUsed: An index named '%s' already exists for this entity.
exceptions.entityTypeIsNotSuitableForUniqueIndexes: Unique indexes can be configured for the Base and Hierarchy entities only.
